title: fix(app-shell): judge the machine-name chip on the untranslated source label (#8231)
body:
Fixes #8231
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The machine-name chip in `SchemaForm`'s `FieldRow` now compares `prettify(name)` with the field's **untranslated source label**, not with the visible label, as ruling 1 (comment 5749674288) requires. Before this change, the zh dashboard panel chipped every translated field while the en panel hid the chip beside the same fields. Now both locales show the same chip set.

- **`field-source-label.ts`** (new leaf with no runtime imports). It holds a module-private symbol with a writer (`stampSourceLabel`) and a reader (`untranslatedFieldLabel`). A field that an overlay translated returns the label it arrived with, which is undefined when the form authored none. A field that no overlay touched returns its own `label`.
- **`metadata-form-i18n.ts`**. Before `resolveMetadataFormLabels` runs, `localizeMetadataForm` stamps every field with its incoming label. It works on copies and never mutates its input. The resolver copies fields with object spread, which carries own symbol keys, so the stamp reaches `SchemaForm`. After resolving, fields the resolver synthesized, such as the `header` composite's bundle-enumerated children, are stamped with an undefined source. An English locale, or a type the bundle does not carry, still returns the same object as before.
- **`SchemaForm.tsx`, `FieldRow`**. The source label is `untranslatedFieldLabel(fieldSpec)`, else `schema.title`, else `prettify(name)`. That is the chain `label` follows with every translation step removed, so it is the label the row would show in English. This also covers the raw-schema road (`translateSchemaFieldLabel`, e.g. `source` shown as 源节点), which had the same defect.
- **`SchemaForm.tsx`, sectioned rows**. The row schema's `title` override now takes the **source** label instead of `f.label`. Without this, `FieldRow`'s `schema.title` fallback would receive the translation that the stamp keeps out, so the fix would not hold. Every reader of the title prefers `fieldSpec.label`, which still holds the translation, so nothing visible changes: `FieldRow` reads `fieldSpec.label` first, and the color widget's `aria-label` reads `fieldSpec?.label` before `schema.title`.
- **`mergeServerFields.ts`**. The form is now copied shallowly instead of being round-tripped through JSON. `JSON.stringify` drops symbol keys, so any dashboard with a server-only field lost the stamp. The function only ever appended a section to a fresh array, and its existing tests stay green.

## The pipe cost: measured small, so option 1 landed and fallback 3 was not taken

- No exported prop or type changed. `FormFieldSpec` is untouched, and so is the `SchemaForm` props type. The stamp is a symbol key: not authorable, not serialized, absent from `Object.keys`. `field-source-label.ts` is not re-exported from the package index.
- The pipe is about 60 lines of leaf module plus about 50 lines in the overlay, and it needed one side fix (the JSON clone in `mergeServerFields`). I measured the import closure: `SchemaForm.tsx` statically reaches one file more than at base (the new leaf; the absolute count is method-dependent: 19 to 20 by the implementer, 24 to 25 by the reviewer), and still zero `@objectstack/spec/system` importers. My first commit read the stamp through the overlay module, which pulled `spec/system` into that closure. The second commit moves the stamp into the leaf.

## Pin rewritten, with its reason (not deleted)

`SchemaForm.deDeveloperize-8218.test.tsx` section 1 used a hand-written 「列数」 label and read the chip beside `columns`. Its comment called the always-on chip the mechanism. That shape was the defect. After this change the old fixture would have **stayed green for the wrong reason**: a hand-written 「列数」 never passes through the overlay, so it counts as its own source. The pin now builds its fixture through the real `localizeMetadataForm`. It asserts the chip is absent beside `gap` (no source label) and present beside `columns` (source label "Grid width"), in both locales. The tooltip assertions use the chip that is present. The comment explains why the earlier shape was the defect this card removes. Section 3 still uses the old `COLUMNS_FORM`, but it only reads the numeric control.

## A ruling premise that did not hold (the direction still holds)

The ruling's example, "shown for `refreshInterval` / Auto refresh everywhere", assumed the spec gives that field an English label. The spec does not. Every `dashboardForm` field is authored without a `label` (only `helpText`), and the field is named `refreshIntervalSeconds`. So in both locales all four layout fields (`columns` / `gap` / `refreshIntervalSeconds` / `header`) now hide the chip, which is what the English panel always did. The "present" half of the predicate is shown with a fixture whose source label does not spell the name ("Grid width" for `columns`), through the real overlay.

## Red before, green after (zh and en)

The fix is committed. I reverted `SchemaForm.tsx`, `metadata-form-i18n.ts` and `mergeServerFields.ts` to base `8b1f06619`, kept the new tests, and restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under an EXIT trap. The restore was proven by `git diff HEAD` being empty and by each path's blob hash matching `HEAD`:
- **Before (base code):** 7 failed / 17 passed as measured by the implementer; the at-tier reviewer re-ran the same procedure and read 6 failed / 18 passed (the same 24 tests, every red named below is red). All the zh predicate cases are red. The zh dashboard chip set is actions, columns, gap, header and one more, against an empty set in en. The raw-schema case chips `source` in zh only, and the rewritten 8218 zh case is red. The en cases are green before and after. That is the inversion: en never showed these chips.
- **After:** those two files plus `mergeServerFields.test.ts`: 3 files, 31 passed.

## Local verification (at `d35e00806`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`: 287 files passed, 3081 tests passed, 1 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose include covers `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0. The dependency closure was built first with `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`, 28 of 28 tasks.
- eslint on the 6 touched source and test files: 0 errors. There are 18 warnings, all on pre-existing lines in `SchemaForm.tsx` / `mergeServerFields.ts`.
- These gates exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, and `governed --test` (NOT GOVERNED).
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure`. Reason: it needs `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` from a console build, which was not run locally. The static-closure measurement above is the local substitute. The full `pnpm test` / `pnpm lint` / `pnpm type-check` runs are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface: the claim named `SchemaForm.tsx`, `metadata-form-i18n.ts`, the 8218 pin, new tests and a changeset. This PR also touches `field-source-label.ts` (new leaf, see above) and `mergeServerFields.ts`, which is the producer-side copy that dropped the stamp. Both are needed for the predicate to hold on the real dashboard path.
- Out of reach today, noted and not changed: the `record` widget rebuilds its key row's spec as a fresh object from `keyField.label`. A translated key label there would lose the stamp. No overlay covers a `record` key today.
- `Spec Main Shape Gate` red, if it appears, is upstream objectui#10287.
